scripts.build:catalog-core: npm run build -w @graph/contracts && npm run build -w @graph/catalog-core && npm run build -w @graph/catalog-ingest && npm run build -w @graph/catalog-json && npm run build -w @graph/json-client
scripts.build:shared: npm run build:catalog-core && npm run build -w @graph/api-client && npm run build -w @graph/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:spfx
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.pretest: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api
